BUG 2 (the genuine capture-lane surface work), distinct from and STACKED ON TOP OF fz-k22.8 (clause-0 demand, bug 1). Confirmed via spike wt-spike-k22b (2026-07-09): with bug 1 fixed, enum_predicate_search now fails on a distinct pre-existing codegen bug -- NativeClosureTargetSurface { capture_count: 1, capture_reprs: [RawAtom] } vs { 0, [] } at native_codegen/driver.rs:940 -- a direct closure-call fast path encoding 1 capture lane where the callee target expects 0/2. Ground-folding of closure captures disagrees across call sites.

INDEPENDENCE CONFIRMED: reproduces on UNTOUCHED fixtures2/00279_enum_find_find_value.fz and at HEAD baseline. SHARED BUG FAMILY: identical NativeClosureTargetSurface assertion at driver.rs:940 holds enum_take_drop_split::{run,build} red -- so fixing this greens TWO matrix fixtures at once.

CORRECT LOCUS = native codegen closure-target SURFACE unification (driver.rs:940), NOT the demand seam. The earlier fix (a) attempt (route through CallEdge::Indirect, thread aggregate capture-surface multiplicity through arg_demands_for_summary) dead-ended on phase-ordering (capture-surface fact lives in transport-layer BoundaryDescr, downstream of the demand seam). Re-diagnose from the SETTLED state that lands only after fz-k22.8. BLOCKED BY fz-k22.8 (must land first to expose the settled non-crashing state this bug lives in).

FIXTURE PATH: fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.{fz,expected.txt,oracle.exs} (discovered by tests/fixture_matrix.rs via fixtures2/behavior).

comments.text:
ADVANCED (not green) via spike 2026-07-09. TWO LAYERS, one step (neither greens a fixture alone -> one commit when both land):

LAYER 1 (prototyped, preserved on branch wt/k22-7-capture-lane @ 66d99ec40): native.rs BackendTail::ClosureCall hard-errored on direct_rejection instead of falling through to the already-correct generic indirect path. Deleting the redundant hard-error (~12 LoC) moves BOTH enum_predicate_search AND enum_take_drop_split past the 'encoded N call lanes for M callee params' error to fail IDENTICALLY at layer 2 -- proving they share one root bug. lib 1279/0/6, warning-free.

LAYER 2 (root-caused, NOT fixed -- the cheap fix is UNSOUND): driver.rs:940 build_codegen_closure_targets asserts one NativeClosureTargetSurface per target_fn. Two BoundaryIds (per closure-literal call site: all?/2 captures a fun -> 1 RawAtom lane; all?/1 ground-folds to 0 lanes) resolve to the same shared recursive body with divergent published_capture_lanes. That target_fn->surface map ALSO compiles the callee's OWN entry ABI (one physical param layout), so 'pick one, skip conflict' trades a clean crash for a silent miscompile. Correct fix must unify capture lanes at the boundary-publication layer (transport) + make the ground-folded 0-capture producer materialize the folded constant into the widened slot -- needs fixpoint-safety review.

NOW: holistic root-cause investigation underway (Output Contract Loop) on wt-k22-7-holistic to trace where the DATA MODEL first goes sour (is capture-surface held at the wrong granularity? is the body-sharing decision ignoring capture ABI? is the ground-fold the rot?) and design the correct-by-construction repair. Full data-model diagnosis to replace this when it returns.

title: fz-k22: shared HOF body reached by 2+ distinct closure CAPTURE surfaces -- the crash is per-call closure-capture evidence, NOT a settle-race or a convergence fold
